en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Ali who said,
‘I saw a seed-shaped cloth upon Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 12. Muhammad ibn ‘Isa has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali who has said the following: “
I saw Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, wearing clothes of lentil color.’”
